audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0..5].side all read 'Skill' while the content layer and the packet chart both name a winner for every row, and phases[6].side named Cassiopeia where content win[6] names Brand.
audit.why: Brand wins levels 1-3 on W poke and the level-3 E-Q stun package; from 4-5 through first item Cassiopeia's 0.75s Twin Fang and Miasma slow take over; at two items Brand's AoE and Pyroclasm out-price her single-target poison in a real fight. Content and packet already agreed on exactly that.
audit.corrected: Full sides moved to Brand, Brand, Brand, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Cassiopeia, Brand, with every why rewritten to match its verdict.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text and whys[4] call her stun 'Petrify (E)' and describe it as a ground.
audit.why: Her E is Twin Fang. The stun is Petrifying Gaze (R), 120/100/80 seconds, and Riot's text says it stuns only enemies facing her — anyone with their back turned is merely slowed. Grounding lives on Miasma (W).
audit.corrected: Both rewritten around Petrifying Gaze (R), the facing requirement, and Twin Fang as the follow-up.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page's whole green-light system was 'Miasma grounds you — dashes and leaps are disabled inside it', repeated in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and report[5].t.
audit.why: Brand has no movement ability anywhere in his kit, so Miasma's grounding is inert against him. What actually punishes him is the slow, which holds him inside Twin Fang's 700 range. Separately, Twin Fang heals Cassiopeia off poisoned targets on a 0.75-second cooldown, so Grievous Wounds decides every extended trade — an interaction the page never mentioned.
audit.corrected: Grounding claim replaced with the slow, and anti-heal timing stated in cooldowns, dontsFull[2].d, mid and wants entries.
sources: ownerKit (no dash flag on any slot)

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit; dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Miasma.
audit.why: Miasma is 24/22/20/18/16 — never fifteen seconds at any rank.
audit.corrected: 24s at rank 1 stated in both fields, plus Twin Fang 0.75s and Petrifying Gaze 120s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Seventeen lintFindings: sixteen misgenderings of Cassiopeia as he/his/him, plus dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d pasted verbatim from tradeGood/tradeBad.
audit.why: Cassiopeia is she/her per champ-gender.js, and a bullet body must match its own title.
audit.corrected: All pronouns corrected in tldr, tradeBad, phases[0].why, phases[2].why, breakdown.wave, breakdown.trading, dosFull[0].t, dontsFull[1].t, dontsFull[2].d and reports 0/3/4/8/9/11; both bled bullets replaced with title-matching text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Brand's W carries a derived 'terrain' flag.
audit.why: Riot's Pillar of Flame text describes delayed area damage only. Flag contradicts description, so it was not used.

edits.before: Her Petrify (E) grounds you the instant she lands it, and once she reaches 6 the grounded stun into full Twin Fang combo threatens to kill you before your own combo lands, making her ultimate window the real turning point.
edits.after: Her stun is Petrifying Gaze (R), not an E, and it only stuns enemies facing her — turn your back and it downgrades to a slow. Twin Fang, a 0.75-second cooldown, is what actually kills you after it, so hold Q for the answer.

edits.before: Level 6 is a genuine danger zone: Cassiopeia's Petrify grounds you and denies your only escape/engage tool, and if she lands it during a poke exchange she can chain into a full combo that outdamages anything you have back. You need to respect her E range entirely at this stage and only all-in when you've baited the ground out or caught her without mana. Once you land your own first item spike, your burst catches back up and starts threatening her squishy HP pool again.
edits.after: Level 6 is a genuine danger zone: Petrifying Gaze stuns everyone facing her, so the instant she ults, turning your back downgrades it to a slow. Miasma's grounding is dead weight against you — Brand owns no dash — and what hurts is its slow holding you inside Twin Fang's 700 range while that 0.75-second cooldown heals her off every poison tick. Buy Grievous Wounds before you plan any long trade, and all-in only when Miasma is spent or her mana is gone. Your first item spike brings the burst back.

notes: The content win[] chart already matched the packet levelChart exactly, so the chart group here only moves the full-layer sides into agreement with it and rewrites each phases[N].why to argue for the verdict shown. No win[N] value needed changing. The page-wide claim that Miasma grounds Brand was wrong in three places — Brand's kit has no movement ability, so grounding is inert; the slow is the threat. Twin Fang's self-heal and the Grievous Wounds timing were absent from the page entirely and are now stated. Brand's W 'terrain' derived flag contradicts Riot's description and was ignored.
